title: Big Data and Integrative Clinical Epidemiology
body_html:
Big Data and Integrative Clinical Epidemiology research focuses on development of a comprehensive database for commonest, anterior and posterior segment eye diseases, with a special focus on Queensland. Our researchers aim to improve understanding of the burden of eye disease in Queensland and analyse services necessary throughout the state.

Through this, local evidence will be produced to improve the quality of eye care and prevent vision loss in Queensland, and Australia.
